verdict.rationale: Gusto's own materials say owners can hire and pay international contractors on its platform, so it does send some cross-border payments. Nothing in the pack covers paying in local currencies, FX handling, or fee transparency, and the new business bank account claims don't mention international transfers. Missing for 10: evidence of local-currency payouts, transparent fee/FX disclosure, international payments beyond contractor payroll (e.g., vendor/AP payments), independent or hands-on corroboration.
